questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code determines which environment's authentication policy applies? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
In STAGING a user submits the correct password but no one-time code. What does LoginService.login do?
choices: Returns a session whose cookie is marked Secure but whose lifetime is shortened
Raises LoginDenied('second factor required') and counts it as a failed login
Raises LoginDenied('invalid credentials') because the password check is repeated with the OTP
Returns a session, since MFA is only enforced in production

questions.prompt: Under the PRODUCTION policy, which next_url does login return unchanged as the redirect target?
IDP_ENV is set to 'Production ' (capital P, trailing space). What does load_policy return?
choices: It raises RuntimeError because the value does not match 'production' exactly
The production policy, because the value is stripped and lower-cased before matching
The development policy, as the fallback for unrecognized values
The staging policy, as the closest match
